text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehe... hehe. How did I do, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehe... hehe. How did I do, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've gotten a lot better, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! Next up is the spring
Tenno Sho,
so—
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that was a fantastic run!
Yeah, that was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I came by myself today... to show my
support.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You were spectacular, just like at the
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Focusing on one goal and forging
ahead... You're
just like a hero leading
her people, worthy of
being
memorialized in legend for generations
to
come!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... I got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, it's okay. Sorry. But... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit embarrassing... but I'm happy
you said
that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I do want to become like the Blue Rose
of Good
Fortune, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Do you remember the last
page?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them talk excitedly about
the book all
the way back to campus.
